faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know about TeacherPoint.
faq.1.q: How do I find the right tutor on TeacherPoint?
faq.1.a: Use our advanced filters — subject, price, location, language, and verified badges — to shortlist tutors. You can chat with up to 3 free trial sessions before booking.
faq.2.a: Yes — every course includes a verified completion certificate that can be shared on LinkedIn and added to your resume.
faq.3.q: Can parents track their child's learning?
faq.3.a: Absolutely. The Parent Dashboard shows enrolled courses, attendance, test scores, and weekly learning hours in real time.
faq.4.a: We accept Razorpay, Stripe, PayPal, UPI, debit/credit cards, and net banking across multiple currencies.
faq.5.a: Yes — 7-day no-questions-asked refund on every course and tutor session purchase.
faq.6.a: Teachers submit ID, qualifications, and complete a demo class. Our review team verifies within 48 hours.
faq.7.q: Do you support live and recorded learning?
faq.7.a: Both. Most courses include lifetime recorded access; tutors offer 1-on-1 live sessions in your timezone.
faq.8.q: Can I become a teacher on TeacherPoint?
faq.8.a: Yes — apply via 'Become a Teacher'. Once verified, you can list courses, accept students, and earn weekly payouts.
